# HunterX — GitHub Discoverability

Guidance for the `nullc0d30/HunterX` GitHub repository metadata. Apply on the
GitHub repository settings page (About panel).

## Repository description

> HunterX v7 — AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, validation & proof engine.
> Orchestrates open-source security tools to discover, validate, prove, and
> report vulnerabilities. Apache 2.0.

## Repository website

```
https://nullc0d30.github.io/HunterX/
```

## Verified topic mapping

| Topic | Why it applies to HunterX v7 |
|---|---|
| `cybersecurity` | Core domain |
| `penetration-testing` | Authorized security assessment platform |
| `bug-bounty` | Report-ready findings and PoCs for bounty programs |
| `vulnerability-scanner` | Discovery/validation workflow (scanner is only one part) |
| `red-team` | Mission orchestration, attack paths, cloud intelligence |
| `security-tools` | Integrates and orchestrates 92 security tools |
| `web-security` | Web application coverage |
| `api-security` | API/GraphQL coverage |
| `cloud-security` | Cloud & SaaS attack-surface intelligence |
| `application-security` | AppSec validated findings |
| `offensive-security` | Offensive platform |
| `ai-security` | AI-assisted reasoning engine |
| `security-research` | Novel/unknown behavior investigation |
| `python` | Implemented in Python |
| `osint` | Reconnaissance and OSINT tooling |
| `reconnaissance` | Recon/asset discovery |
| `vulnerability-validation` | Evidence-driven validation engine |
| `poc-generation` | Proof & PoC engine |
| `security-automation` | Mission orchestration and automation |
| `security-testing` | Authorized security testing |

## Notes

- HunterX publishes to PyPI as **`hunterxsec`**; the plain `hunterx` name on
  PyPI belongs to an unrelated project. The canonical install paths are
  `pip install hunterxsec`, `install.sh`, or source install from this
  repository.
- **Do not** add topics like `zero-day`, `exploitation`, or `malware` — they
  are not supported by the product.
